description: Unsigned mint(qty) transaction plus the x402 URL. The caller signs and sends it, and the punks go to the sending wallet (msg.sender). This server never holds keys or funds. mint(qty) mints to msg.sender. Gas: about 111k units for mint(1) (measured on mainnet), more for each extra punk; about 175k for a free claim. Always run estimateGas, gas price varies.

from.description: optional: the wallet you will send from. Only copied into the tx for convenience; the punks always go to the actual sender.

name: mint
